newsitem.title: USA: Four FBI agents may be disciplined over Jewell - paper.
newsitem.headline: Four FBI agents may be disciplined over Jewell - paper.

text.p: Four agents from the FBI's Atlanta office, including the special agent in charge, have been told they may be disciplined for their roles in the case of former Olympic bomb suspect Richard Jewell, a newspaper reported Saturday.

The Atlanta Journal-Constitution said the FBI Office of Professional Responsibility (OPR) notified the four that they could face sanctions ranging from reprimands to short suspensions without pay. FBI officials were not immediately available to comment on the article.
The four men were identified as special agent in charge Woody Johnson, assistant special agent in charge A.B. Llewellyn and special agents Diader Rosario and Don Johnson.
OPR issued letters to all four agents, citing them for poor judgment but no policy violations, the article said.
The action stemmed from an interview with Jewell, held at the FBI Atlanta office last July 30, the day he was named by the Atlanta Journal as the only suspect in the Olympic park bombing.

The FBI has been examining techniques used in the interview since Jewell's attorneys alleged that agents tricked their client into talking to interrogators by saying they were only making a training film. Jewell has alleged that agents tried to get him to waive his rights during the interview.

Jewell was working as a security guard at Centennial Olympic Park when he noticed a suspicous-looking military-style backpack at a crowded outdoor concert and reported it to police. The backpack contained a 40-pound pipe bomb that detonated as he helped clear concert-goers from the area.
The blast left two people dead and more than 100 injured. Jewell initially was hailed as a hero. But he soon became the only named suspect in the investigation.
He was never charged with any crime. And after spending three months being hounded by the FBI and the news media, he was publicly exonerated of any suspicion by the Justice Department.
